QuestInfo.0: #p1012106# would like to ask you for a favor.

0.0: I've got more lunchies ready!! Would you be a sweetie and go hand them out?

yes.0: Take this over to #b#p1012111##k, who's very likely deeply engrossed in some more of that silly Golem research.

no.0: I suppose you're busy, even though I know for a fact #p1012111# is starving to death.

1.0: Hello there, young person! You look very hip. Are you my new assistant?\r\n#L0##bNo, #p1012106# sent you some lunch.#l\n#k
1.1: #p1012106# sent you, eh? How unfortunate. I was really hoping you'd help me test this ancient bone disintegrator I found.

yes.0: Oh well! I suppose I can find somebody else's bones to turn into powder. I was getting hungry anyway. But not for bones! Hahahaha! I'm such a wise cracker.

npc.0: #bBruce#k is just standing around in #m100040000#, as usual. Take this #bpacked lunch#k to him.
